title: Frozen-M8 independent confirmation, corrected lesion noninferiority audit, alternative-provider runtime qualification, and conditional official validation submission

C0.fold_weighting: equal arithmetic mean in original checkpoint order
C0.reconstruction: hierarchy-safe ET subset TC subset WT

M8.meaning: the original prediction plus all seven nonempty flip combinations

prohibited: size-based exclusion or filtering of lesions
folds 3-4 access before the committed freeze
using stored nnU-Net internal-validation predictions as confirmation evidence
deletion of C0, checkpoints, archives, credentials, volumes or historical evidence

disclosure.statement: G85 is an owner-authorized protocol amendment written with full knowledge of G84's calibration result. The candidate was chosen before this stage and is frozen by hash. Independent primary evidence comes from confirmation folds 3-4, which no stage has ever opened.

corrected_lesion_analysis.rationale: The historical auxiliary counter is not a one-to-one detection confusion matrix: TP counts predicted components overlapping any reference, FN counts reference components with no predicted overlap, and ET/TC/WT are counted separately. TP+FN is therefore not invariant and derived precision/recall/F1 must remain diagnostic only. A zero-tolerance FN veto is brittle because one extra missed component can veto an otherwise robust all-component gain.

definitions.n_ref: number of reference connected components; depends only on the reference and is therefore policy-invariant
definitions.fn_ref: reference components with zero predicted overlap
definitions.fp_pred: predicted components with zero reference overlap
definitions.tp_pred_diagnostic: predicted components overlapping any reference; DIAGNOSTIC ONLY

margins_frozen_before_confirmation.point_margin_meaning: at most one additional missed reference component per 400 reference components

corrected_lesion_analysis.nature: noninferiority safety gates; they do not reward an FN increase and do not erase G84's failure; they replace the invalid zero-tolerance veto only for the new untouched confirmation decision
diagnostic_only_never_a_release_gate: how many additional misses are smaller than 50 voxels

confirmation.oof_rule: each subject predicted only by the checkpoint trained without it

evaluator.path: preserved read-only environment; site-packages never modified

pooled_all_five_folds.construction: the immutable G84 fold-0-2 records combined with the new G85 fold-3-4 records

order: private ephemeral exact NVIDIA A10G 24 GB via the configured Hugging Face account
RunPod NVIDIA L4 24 GB as a conservative proxy
optimization_order: retain all five predictors if VRAM passes
otherwise reuse one network loading frozen checkpoint states sequentially in the original order

labels.l4: conservative L4 runtime proxy; not exact A10G acceptance

official_validation_submission.partitioning: deterministic, disjoint, exhaustive; exactly one flat prediction per expected case; at least ten deterministic cases compared against single-path execution with exact voxel and geometry equality
official_validation_submission.archive_gates: all 17 G80 gates, before and after independent re-extraction
official_validation_submission.scorer_row_anomaly: handled exactly as in G80: prove the archive contains all 451, report official denominators and NaNs, use comparable rows privately if possible, never attribute the missing row without evidence, never invent a case or denominator
official_validation_submission.queue_identifiers_redacted_for_public_ex: The organizer evaluation-queue identifiers recorded in this object were intentionally removed from the public export and are null above. The exact frozen private originals are preserved unchanged in the private repository. No scientific parameter, gate, threshold, result or chronology was altered by this redaction.

resource_policy.liveness: exact /proc/<pid>/cmdline identity; never a broad pgrep -f or pkill -f; never let SSH consume an orchestration-loop stdin or heredoc
resource_policy.restarts: at most one automatic restart per task; a repeated identical failure stops the phase

governing_rule: If anything is ambiguous, inconsistent, unavailable, statistically unconvincing or operationally unsafe, retain C0.
